title: melanthera venosa
intro: Melanthera venosa, commonly known as the Red Mallow, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Melanthera venosa include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
